finding: The packet pinned trainer image ft-2026-08-21b (pushed 2026-08-20). Warm-start support (MEDZEN_STUDENT_INIT_MODE, MEDZEN_STUDENT_INIT_S3_URI/_VERSION_ID/_SHA256 and the STUDENT_WARM_START_LOADED marker) landed in commit 2de8a58 on 2026-08-27, SEVEN DAYS AFTER that image was built. The image therefore ignored every MEDZEN_STUDENT_INIT_* variable and initialised from the base model card. The run is a base-initialised control, not an Arm-1 warm start.
evidence: The CloudWatch log for the run contains ZERO occurrences of 'student', 'warm', 'arm1' or the Arm-1 hash c6604a68; it goes straight from the mix-load line to TRAIN_PROGRESS step 500. git log -S confirms both the env parsing and the STUDENT_WARM_START_LOADED marker first appear in 2de8a58 (2026-08-27 12:00:17 -0400).
why_it_passed_validation: scripts/b5_sagemaker_job.py runs the CURRENT repo's parse_config at packet time, which accepts MEDZEN_STUDENT_INIT_*. Nothing checks that the PINNED IMAGE understands those variables, so a packet can silently buy different training than it declares. This is a real gap in the launcher, surfaced by independent review (Codex), not a defect in the data.

run_facts.mix: 4 manifests at curated version cp1; 10731 eligible rows; 0 rejected

retained_because: A base-initialised control on the same data, seed and schedule is a genuinely useful comparator for the warm-started run. It is NOT to be read as an Arm-1 warm-start result and no gate is applied to it.
